description: This file defines an internal sealed class ClusterConnectionStatusObserverAdaptor which implements IClusterConnectionStatusObserver. It acts as an adaptor for cluster connection status events, handling notifications for connection lost events and gateway count changes, and logging errors as needed.

classes.name: ClusterConnectionStatusObserverAdaptor
classes.description: An internal sealed class that adapts cluster connection status events, handling lost connection and gateway count change notifications, and logging errors.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies all registered handlers of a cluster connection loss, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies all registered handlers of a change in gateway count, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: LogErrorSendingClusterConnectionLostNotification
methods.description: Logs an error when sending the cluster connection lost notification.

methods.name: LogErrorSendingGatewayCountChangedNotification
methods.description: Logs an error when sending the gateway count changed notification.
